newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CEN BANK OFFERS TO ADD LIQUIDITY IN REV REPO.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CEN BANK OFFERS TO ADD LIQUIDITY IN REV REPO.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) offered on Wednesday to add liquidity to the money market through a three billion crown overnight reverse repo tender, the CNB said in a statement.
The central bank did not set a limit yield. Overnight money on the Prague interbank offered rate (PRIBOR) was trading at an average of 172.1 percent on Wednesday, down from 186.1 percent on Tuesday.

The central bank said on Monday after floating the crown that it was ready to add liquidity to the interbank market stretched by the CNB's restrictive measures taken during a battle against currency speculators.
The central bank raised its Lombard rate to 50 percent from 14 percent on May 16 and the discount rate to 13 percent from 10.5 percent on Tuesday.
It said it would adjust its repo rates according to market conditions and gradually bring them down from last week's 75 percent.
